parts:
Here are a few **sexy, intimate, but still classy** good-night messages that hit when you’re not used to sleeping apart 💫

Soft + longing  
- “Goodnight, love. This bed feels way too big without you. Come back to me soon.”  
- “I’m falling asleep wishing I was curled up right where you belong… next to me.”  
- “I’ll be dreaming of you tonight. Try not to keep me waiting too long.”

Flirty + intimate  
- “Goodnight… but just so you know, I’m saving all of this energy for you when we’re back together.”  
- “Sleep well. I plan on making up for this distance very soon.”  
- “I’m heading to bed, but my body is definitely missing yours.”

Confident + seductive  
- “Goodnight handsome. Don’t get too comfortable without me.”  
- “Go to sleep knowing exactly who you’re coming home to.”  
- “Sweet dreams… I’ll be right there in your head.”

Deep connection vibe  
- “Even apart, you’re still the safest place I land. Goodnight.”  
- “Distance doesn’t change a thing. I’m yours tonight and always.”  

If you want, tell me:
- sweeter or spicier 🌙  
- playful or deeply romantic 🔥  
- short text or slow-burn voice-note energy 🎧  

I can tailor one that sounds *exactly* like you.
Sexy inteehing way to say GN to your boyfriend who who haven't slept away from in a few months
